concerns.text: SC-001 requires that the primary correlation coefficient be evaluated against the null distribution, but no verification step checks that the observed r exceeds or is compared to the null‑distribution expectation (e.g., p < 0.05 relative to shuffled‑ID control).
SC-003 mandates the pipeline complete within 6 h on a free‑tier runner; there is no task verification that measures or enforces this runtime limit.
SC-005 calls for an explicit acknowledgement of the single‑test nature or a multiple‑comparison correction, yet no task verifies that such a statement appears in the output/report.
Tasks T013‑T015 are not tagged with any FR or SC identifiers, making them orphan tasks that do not demonstrably satisfy any documented requirement.
